THE HUNTER PREVIEW

WoW Forever Hunter talents by tree

50 talents · 15 new · 24 changed

Explore WoW Forever Hunter talents tree by tree. Beast Mastery feeds the pet and the new hawks, Marksmanship builds the shot rotation up to Sniper Shot, and Survival adds melee talents ending in Lacerating Strikes. Linked names open their recorded ranks; new and changed labels describe data, not strength.

Beast Mastery talents

New: Focused Fire, Summon Hawk.

Final row: Bestial Wrath. Requires 30 points in earlier Beast Mastery rows, plus any listed prerequisite.

Marksmanship talents

New: Careful Aim, Rapid Killing, Lone Wolf, Rapid Recuperation, Sniper Shot.

Final row: Sniper Shot. Requires 30 points in earlier Marksmanship rows, plus any listed prerequisite.

Survival talents

New: Improved Tracking, Survival Tactics, Predator's Edge, Resourcefulness, Expose Prey, Survivalist's Discipline, Strider Kick, Lacerating Strikes.

Final row: Lacerating Strikes. Requires 30 points in earlier Survival rows, plus any listed prerequisite.

WoW Forever Hunter abilities: what changed outside the talents

3 abilities

Some of the biggest Hunter changes are trained spells rather than talents. These 3 notes come from the level 60 Beta spellbook; each one links to the talents that reference it. Ranks and levels can still change before launch.

Aimed ShotNow trainable

Trainable instead of a Marksmanship talent, with a 2 sec cast where Classic had 3 sec, and a 6 sec cooldown shared with Multi-Shot. Six ranks, first trained at 20.

Barrage

Call PetChanged

Call Pet summons your pet. The Beta book uses that generic name rather than a pet-specific title such as Call Owl.

Aspect of the BeastChanged

Rank 1 makes you untrackable and adds 50 melee attack power; Classic only made you untrackable.

Deadly Aspects

How to plan WoW Forever Hunter talents

Plan WoW Forever Hunter talents around one early decision: pet or no pet. Lone Wolf in Marksmanship adds 20% damage while no pet is active, while Focused Fire, Unleashed Fury and Ferocity in Beast Mastery only help while a pet is summoned. Settle that first, then trace that tree's prerequisites backwards.

Set your level and budget

Choose a level before spending WoW Forever Hunter talents; it sets the budget, 21 points at 30 and 51 at 60, shared by all three trees. Bestial Wrath, Sniper Shot and Lacerating Strikes each need 30 points in earlier rows of their tree, so a 51-point plan reaches one of them with 20 points to spare; a 21-point plan reaches none.

Learn and refund ranks

Learning is a click, refunding a right-click or Shift-click; touch users tap once to inspect and again to learn. Locked WoW Forever Hunter talents show what they wait for: Summon Hawk needs 15 Beast Mastery points, Lone Wolf 10 in Marksmanship, and Strider Kick 20 in Survival. Keyboard users reach a node with Tab and learn with Enter or Space.

Reach the later rows

Row two unlocks after 5 points in earlier rows of the same tree, row three after 10, so later WoW Forever Hunter talents depend on their own tree. Survival stacks its new talents in row five: Resourcefulness, Expose Prey and Strider Kick share one row. To back out, refund dependants before their prerequisite or reset the whole tree.

Save and share WoW Forever Hunter talents

A Hunter keeps more than one plan: a Beast Mastery spread, a Marksmanship layout, a Survival melee build. Your current allocation of WoW Forever Hunter talents saves as one draft; open My builds, name a setup such as Marks 31/20 and choose Save build to keep several. Names stay on this device.

Hand WoW Forever Hunter talents to a friend with Copy build. The link stores class, level, every rank and data version, so they open your Bestial Wrath or Sniper Shot path. Select the link in the field if the clipboard refuses, or use Share where the device offers it. Saves stay local, so keep a link before clearing browser data.

WoW Forever Hunter talents FAQ

Answers for preview changes, source coverage and saved setups.

How do WoW Forever Hunter talents differ from Classic?+

Of the Hunter talents in this preview, 15 are marked new and 24 changed. Aimed Shot is now trained rather than talented, and Sniper Shot takes its place at the end of Marksmanship; Entrapment now roots every trapped target for 1 sec. Compare to Classic shows the Classic wording beside the new.

Are all talent ranks verified?+

This snapshot of WoW Forever Hunter talents records 148 rank descriptions and leaves 0 slots blank. Frenzy, Improved Concussive Shot and Ranged Weapon Specialization, plus Careful Aim and Mortal Shots, now have every rank written. The full reference still marks any later gap.

Can I restore WoW Forever Hunter talents on another device?+

Yes, with a build link. Open it in the other browser and it restores class, level and every point, whether a 31-point Marksmanship plan or a Survival layout. Named saves and drafts are stored only in the browser that made them. A link from an older data version explains the mismatch and keeps its address available.

Are these the best WoW Forever Hunter talents?+

No. It checks that a setup fits its budget, row gates and prerequisites and stops there; it does not simulate damage or pet uptime. Compare WoW Forever Hunter talents by reading the recorded effects: Careful Aim scales with Intellect, Lone Wolf only counts without a pet. In-game testing decides the rest.
